transcript.text: t/d keeps cutting out after 10 mins then starts again if i leave it. vent hose goes out the window. pls help

This behaviour is very typical of a tumble dryer overheating and triggering its safety cut-out. The most common cause is restricted airflow, which makes the unit get too hot, shut down to protect itself, and then restart once it cools down. Please check two things:
1. Is the fluff filter (usually in the door opening) clean and free of lint?
2. Is the vent hose leading out to the window completely straight with no kinks or squashed sections?
[Safety panel] Overheating can be a fire risk. Clean the lint filter and make sure the airflow/vent isn't blocked, and don't leave the dryer running unattended. If it smells of burning, stop using it and unplug it.
filter is cleaned every time. the hose is kinked tho, i pushed the dryer back further recently and its squashed behind it. also the cabinet gets really hot before it stops

Please straighten the vent hose so it is not kinked or compressed behind the machine, then run a cycle again. If it still cuts out after 10 minutes even with the hose clear, I will need the make and model number (usually on a sticker inside the door opening) to check if there is another blockage in the condenser or heat exchanger.
[Safety panel] Overheating can be a fire risk. Clean the lint filter and make sure the airflow/vent isn't blocked, and don't leave the dryer running unattended. If it smells of burning, stop using it and unplug it.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
